front.article-title: The Two Rooms: An Entirely Invented Symbol-Scope Example

sec.title: Invented coating room
sec.p: This passage is synthetic and does not come from a publication or platform case. Here r denotes the pore radius, measured in nm.
The first room contains only this abstract display: r

sec.title: Invented circuit room
sec.p: In a separate thought experiment, r denotes the total resistance, while r_1 and r_2 denote its two branch contributions. No unit is stated for these resistance symbols.
The second room displays the invented relationship r=r1+r2 without assigning a numerical value.
